name: Survey of Violence Experienced by Staff — German revised hospital survey
question_count: 65 SOVES baseline per Schnelli 2021 and Lucien et al 2022; precise revised question roster pending
measured_domains: Workplace violence experiences; incident types; 12-month and past-week frequency; perpetrator/context; consequences and support; post-incident responses; includes component scales in some editions
provenance: Hahn et al 2011 N291 German-speaking Swiss general-hospital nurses; DOI 10.1111/j.1365-2702.2011.03768.x; 65-question description Schnelli 2021 and Lucien et al 2022
respondent_language_status: DE-CH German administered/revised; feasibility evidence not comprehensive validation; EN original separate; RU ES none
commercial_digital_use: Not verified. Require original McKenna SOVES and Hahn derivative rights, exact wording, digital commercial consent; 2011 Wiley paper is not item reproduction license
verification_and_safety: RESEARCH ONLY. SOVES is a multi-section workplace incident survey, not one diagnostic factor score. Seven vs eight sections across sources, baseline 65 questions to verify; do not conflate embedded POAS-S, POIS and IMPACS with whole SOVES.

name: Survey of Violence Experienced by Staff — French-speaking Swiss home-care contextual adaptation
question_count: 65 in antecedent SOVES-G-R reported; exact adapted SOVES-Fr-HC questions UNVERIFIED, do not assume 65
measured_domains: Workplace violence frequency, context, consequences, management and support, caregiver perceptions of aggression (embedded POAS-S12) and perceived intervention skills (embedded POIS9). Composite sections not independent factorial subscales
provenance: Lucien et al BMC Health Services Research 2026-10-27 DOI 10.1186/s12913-026-15990-1; 8-expert forward/backward face-validity adaptation; N175 eligible French-speaking Swiss home-care workers, POAS N174, POIS N169
respondent_language_status: FR-CH context-adapted and face-validity only, NOT comprehensively psychometrically validated or independent confirmed translation; EN0 RU0 ES0 new
population: N175 home-care caregivers western Switzerland; one cohort shared with POAS and POIS entries
commercial_digital_use: Article CC BY 4.0 does not establish commercial web rights of underlying SOVES, POAS, POIS items and French derivative; obtain approval of all authors/rights owners and exact version/score manual
verification_and_safety: RESEARCH ONLY. Composite distinct from already-registered 2026 POAS-S and POIS embedded subscales; do not count those participants as independent samples. POAS total omega .64 inadequate, POIS omega .88 but factor model derived and tested in same data; no routine clinical or occupational risk decisions.
